title: Entity Output Switch
text: Output entities, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Switching criterion} sets the switching criterion First port that is not; {Number of output ports} sets the number of output ports, {Initial port selection} sets the output port at the start, {Switch Attribute name} sets the attribute that determines the output port and {Seed} sets the seed. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Number of output ports
params.values: Specify the number of output ports 2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Switching criterion
params.values: Choose the switching criterion First port that is not blocked (default) | Round robin | From control port | From attribute | Equiprobable

params.name: Initial port selection
params.values: Specify the output port at the start of the simulation 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Switch Attribute name
params.values: Specify the attribute that determines the output port Attribute1 (default) | character vector
